description: One collection, three corners, loudest last: hold the Db-major collection for the whole track and drift the tonic Db -> F minor -> Ab major, put the loudest stretch early (3:00-5:00) as the first corner, spend the middle in a long bright valley, then punch the deepest hole in the track five seconds before the loudest sustained passage and stop at full volume with no coda. The climax is the last thing that happens.
name: geometry_of_belief

sections.name: Intro
sections.notes: Sparse statement of the collection. One early dip to -19.6dB at 0:15 — the hole device, previewed small. Centroid ~2933Hz.

sections.name: Opening statement (Db major)
sections.notes: Db major, the most confident key stretch in the track (C# maj 0.80-0.93). Steady build; the second minute is the loudest of the opening (-11.2dB). Grid-locked, no tempo drift.

sections.name: Peak A
sections.notes: Loudest stretch before the finale: max 5s RMS -9.1dB at 4:50, peak -0.8dB at 3:15. Keys churn through the collection's labels at low confidence (0.64-0.72) — the least settled harmony, at the loudest level. This is a corner, not the climax.

sections.name: Valley (F minor)
sections.notes: Quietest sustained stretch (first minute mean -16.1dB) and the brightest timbre in the track (centroid ~3449Hz, ZCR ~0.153). F minor held stable — nine straight key windows, F chroma 0.67-0.71. Deep dips cluster at 5:45-6:30 (-17.0 to -17.7dB). Emptiness reads thin and noisy, not dark.

sections.name: Rebuild (Ab major)
sections.notes: Tonicization completes toward Ab: G# chroma 0.66 rising to 0.77. Dips keep the floor unstable (-17.1, -17.9dB at 9:00-9:05; -19.0dB at 10:40 just before the finale). Never settles, but never collapses either.

sections.name: Finale (hole + slam)
sections.notes: Deepest dip in the track (-19.8dB at 11:40), then the loudest sustained passage in the piece (11:45-12:23, -9.3 to -10.9dB, mean ~-10.0dB). Final 5s window darkens hard (centroid 1606Hz, rolloff 3855Hz, ZCR 0.033). Hard stop at 12:23.0 at -9.3dB — a stomp, not a fade, no coda, no comedown.

source_track: YOLO SNIPES - GEOMETRY OF BELIEF (track 11, INTERNALISM)
